lessons.title: Body Parts

items.exampleMeaning: I have pain in my arm.
I have a pain in my neck.

lessons.tip: In Italian, some body parts are feminine and some are masculine. For example, 'la testa' is feminine and 'il braccio' is masculine. Pay attention to the articles to use them correctly.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Non sto bene. Mi fa male la testa.
dialogue.meaning: I don’t feel well. My head hurts.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mi dispiace. Hai bisogno di qualcosa?
dialogue.meaning: I’m sorry. Do you need something?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sì, ho anche mal di collo.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I also have a pain in my neck.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who asks about your health
scenario.learnerRole: someone who is not feeling well
scenario.brief: You are talking to a friend. Tell them what hurts. Ask for advice.
scenario.goal: You should express your symptoms and receive advice.

lessons.title: Describing Pain

items.exampleMeaning: I have pain in my back.
I should go to the doctor.

lessons.tip: When describing pain, use 'fa male' followed by the body part. For example, 'Mi fa male la gamba' means 'My leg hurts.'

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mi fa male il braccio e ho dolore alla schiena.
dialogue.meaning: My arm hurts and I have pain in my back.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sì, è gonfio e non posso muovere il collo.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it is swollen and I cannot move my neck.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: You should go to the doctor.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who is concerned about your pain
scenario.brief: You are explaining your symptoms to a friend. Use the phrases to describe what hurts.
scenario.goal: You should clearly describe your pain and consider going to the doctor.

lessons.title: At the Pharmacy

items.example: Ho una ricetta per la medicina.
items.exampleMeaning: I have a prescription for the medicine.
Read the instructions of the medicine.

lessons.tip: When you need medicine, you can say 'Ho bisogno di medicina'. If you have a prescription, say 'Ho una ricetta'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hai la ricetta per la medicina?
dialogue.meaning: Do you have the prescription for the medicine?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sì, e ho bisogno di prendere il farmaco.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, and I need to take the drug.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: You’re right, I will do it.

scenario.brief: You are at the pharmacy. Ask for the medicine and discuss the prescription.
scenario.goal: You should successfully communicate your needs at the pharmacy.

lessons.title: Giving Health Advice

items.exampleMeaning: You must drink a lot of water.
It is important to eat healthy.

items.example: Devi stare attento alla tua salute.
items.exampleMeaning: You must be careful with your health.

items.example: È bene rilassarsi dopo una lunga giornata.
items.exampleMeaning: It is good to relax after a long day.

lessons.tip: When giving advice, use 'Dovresti' for 'You should' or 'Devi' for 'You must'. These phrases help express recommendations clearly.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dovresti dormire di più e bere molta acqua.
dialogue.meaning: You should sleep more and drink a lot of water.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Devi mangiare sano e fare esercizio.
dialogue.meaning: You must eat healthy and exercise.

scenario.brief: You are asking a friend for health advice. Use the phrases to suggest solutions.
scenario.goal: You should give and receive health advice effectively.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Non bene. Mi fa male la gamba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sì, ho una ricetta per la medicina.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have a prescription for the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: You should drink a lot of water.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend checking on your health
scenario.learnerRole: someone discussing their health and advice
scenario.brief: You are reviewing what you learned about health. Discuss your symptoms and advice with a friend.
scenario.goal: You should practice discussing health topics and advice.
